summary: preinstall hook exfiltrates host reconnaissance to pipedream webhook via hex-obfuscated curl
details: The package's preinstall lifecycle hook (preinstall.js) reads a hex-encoded string from preinstall.json, decodes it with Buffer.from(hexCommand, 'hex'), and passes the result to child_process.exec. The decoded command runs `whoami`, `pwd`, and `hostname` on the installer's host and POSTs the collected identifiers to https://eousft8gflamm91.m.pipedream.net, a third-party webhook endpoint unrelated to the package's stated purpose. The hex encoding conceals both the destination URL and the reconnaissance commands from casual inspection of the tarball. The behavior fires automatically on `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
